purpose: Immutable fusion-model comparison reference for the EXP-01..EXP-06 ablation series in MM_RETINA_NEXT_EXPERIMENTS.md.

dataset.note: The GAMMA 'testing' split (100 more raw samples) has no public ground-truth labels anywhere on disk (verified, see dataset/audit_report.json -> full_dataset_availability) -- 100 labeled patients is the real full supervised dataset, not a partial view of ~300.

split.note: Fold assignment is deterministic given (manifest, k=5, seed=42) and is identical to the original cv-run-1 (2026-09-17) fold membership -- verified by construction in cross_validate.py's make_folds(), not re-derived by hand.

checkpoints_note: Per-fold checkpoints deleted after evaluation (cross_validate.py default) -- only metrics/confusion_matrix/predictions are kept, which is everything needed to reproduce the numbers in metrics.json without retraining.

supersedes.why_rerun_instead_of_reused: cv-run-1 predates Cohen's Kappa / QWK support in evaluate.py's compute_classification_metrics(). Per the experimental rule 'same evaluation code', this baseline was re-run under the current pipeline (identical seed/folds/hyperparameters) rather than reusing cv-run-1's partial metric set, so EXP-02 onward can be compared metric-for-metric, including kappa/QWK.
supersedes.reproducibility_caveat: accuracy/balanced_accuracy/macro_f1/roc_auc differ slightly from cv-run-1's original fusion numbers (e.g. mean accuracy 0.731 here vs 0.710 in cv-run-1) despite an identical seed and fold assignment. This is expected GPU-training non-determinism (cuDNN algorithm selection, etc. -- no determinism flags were set on either run) not a bug in either run; both are real, honestly reported results from their own real training runs.
